acceptance_limits: This review authorizes parent isolated compilation only. Rust type/visibility/stack properties await the actual native compiler and disassembly; no compiled or runtime PASS is claimed.
An observation cap or invalid phase is an evidence failure and excludes acceptance even if actual callback later succeeds.

Physical response/ring snapshots, original serial lifetime checks, host task/UART acknowledgement, actual module/image/build provenance, launcher wait status, same-OS followups and error/quarantine semantics remain independently required.
Typed owner parser remains comparison-only; future evaluator must explicitly validate additional STABILITY_FAULT and STABILITY_PHASE schemas/counts and bind mode names through this fixed mapping.
Actual physical-full-ring/recovery qualifications remain open; callback EAGAIN injection must not close them.
callback_and_lifetime_conclusions: Nonmatching requests use the original send unchanged. Selected hard mode returns EIO before invoking actual channel publication.

Modes2 and3 never manufacture send success: actual ControlChannel.publish callback must return Ok. Actual failures propagate unchanged and do not set published. OutboundQueue remains the unchanged sole-producer try_enqueue path.

Completion::publish accesses final response and releases its claim only after actual wake-send success; mode2 notification injection is later, under the same application publication mutex, after response release/call completion. Its one-shot exact-owner latch cannot convert that publication to a retry.
Mode3 and mode4 inject EAGAIN without filling or modifying the physical ring. This is a real guest callback-failure injection test, not physical-full-ring evidence.

Original global delivery Token allocation does not wrap/reuse. Added actual native Claim matching also binds OS generation and original response allocation identity; response-address recycling alone cannot retrigger selection.

RET current HostWorker comes from referenced ProcessId::thread authority. The same Linux worker cannot enter RET until WAIT finishes SELECTED logging; parser still rejects missing/reordered/mismatched triplets.
The recorded RET errno is the real public Result of Registration.invoke (including its existing FFI status normalization); it is not inferred from transport error or launcher wait status.
